item.text: The exporter joins values with commas without CSV quoting. Names only stay in one column because their commas are replaced with semicolons, which conflicts with the documented requirement to preserve customer text. I’ll add shared CSV escaping so names and companies retain their contents, including commas, quotes, and line breaks.
